title: SAVA Gelaro SF6-CUES Carbon Gravel Bike (current product page)
notes: Current manufacturer page identifies Gelaro SF6, publishes the same six-size R21 geometry table, states 700x40C stock tires and 45C maximum compatibility, and lists CUES U6000 11S/U6020 10S options. It displays an approximately 10.4 kg claim for the U6000 11S configuration, but that weight is not propagated to the generic CUES variant because the selected drivetrain option is not uniquely proven. The displayed price is USD and is not imported as a mainland CNY observation.
